query: What static-analysis rules and threat model will detect anti-circularity (data leakage, feature provenance), and what reproducible audit script will auto-halt if provenance tags or checks fail?

response.query: What static-analysis rules and threat model will detect anti-circularity (data leakage, feature provenance), and what reproducible audit script will auto-halt if provenance tags or checks fail?
response.answer: Static-analysis tools like Dataflow Analysis and Taint-Tracking detect anti-circularity. A reproducible audit script using these rules will halt execution if provenance checks fail.
